purpose: Development comparisons; official Adult test excluded; HTRU2 sealed evidence preserved
cluster_quota: reserve one per effective cluster; allocate remaining proportional to cluster size by capped Hamilton rounds
within_cluster_selection: stable distance and row-ID sort; floor(linspace(0,n_cluster-1,quota)); midpoint rank when quota=1
preprocessing: fit on selected training rows only for classifier; numeric median imputation then population standard scaling; categorical mode imputation and full one-hot; unknown all zero; all-missing numeric=0 and categorical=__MISSING__
geometry_preprocessing: fit on current full training partition; same imputation; ordinary numeric mean/std without clipping, robust numeric original median/IQR with 1%-99% clipping; one-hot blocks divided by sqrt(category count)
